title: The ice-blue trench
alt: A model wears a flowing ice-blue trench coat beside a continuous concrete stairway.
description: A complete fashion portrait with asymmetric tailoring, natural anatomy and coherent moving fabric.
prompt: A sophisticated full-length editorial photograph of an adult East Asian male model wearing an elaborate ice-blue trench coat in a concrete courtyard. The coat has a large asymmetric lapel, two coherent sleeves, a connected belt tied naturally at the waist and pleated fabric panels that move gently in the wind. Black trousers and plain black shoes, natural hands resting loosely at the sides, one continuous architectural stairway behind him. High-end fashion lighting, realistic skin and fabric construction, no logos or letters.
